outcome.goal: Add CSV export for the currently filtered results table.
outcome.deliverable: Working local change and a brief account of verification and remaining limits.

facts.text: The table already supports filtering and column selection.
The export button belongs beside the existing print button.

dependencies.text: The filter state is read from the FilterContext provider.

criteria.text: Compare exported rows with the filtered table; they match.
Compare CSV headers with visible columns; order matches.

requirements.text: Export only rows matching the active filters.

requirements.rationale: Downstream spreadsheets rely on the column positions.

requirements.text: Use a semicolon as the field separator.
Name the file after the active view.
Do not add a PDF export.
Large exports may block the interface while streaming.
